newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Nov mutual fund assets rise to $3.55 trillion.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Nov mutual fund assets rise to $3.55 trillion.

text.p: The Investment Company Institute said on Monday that the nation's mutual funds had combined assets of $3.55 trillion at the end of November.
That compares with $3.39 trillion at the end of October. The institute said that 6,243 funds were covered in the November report, up from 6,201 in October.
The institute said in a survey that stock funds had assets of $1.76 trillion at the end of November, compared with $1.65 trillion at the end of October. It surveyed 2,578 stock funds in November.
Net new cash flow into mutual funds amounted to $33.60 billion in November, compared with $34.52 billion in October.
Net flows into stock funds increased to $17.11 billion, from $13.55 billion in October.
Through the first 11 months of this year, stock funds enjoyed a record net cash inflow of $209.81 billion. That compares with $111.84 billion in the like 1995 period.
Institute chief economist John Rhea said that the increased investment in stock funds last month came amid a surge in Wall Street equity prices.
Growth and global equity funds in particular experienced sharp cash flow increases in November.
